info.title: bv
info.description: A .NET global CLI tool that helps implement better development workflows, both locally and in CI.

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: Specifies the amount of information to be displayed (Quiet, Minimal, Normal, Verbose, Diagnostic)

options.name: --exclusive
options.description: Executes the target task without any dependencies

options.name: /p
options.description:
Passes custom properties to MSBuild
Tasks:
Build     Build all projects
Pack      Build all projects, run tests, and prepare build artifacts
Prepare   Prepare
Release   Publish a new public release (CI only)
Restore   Restore dependencies
Test      Build all projects and run tests
